CalcStep.description:
A single self-documenting line in a calculation.

`label`   - human-readable name of the variable ("Operating Expenses").
`value`   - the numeric result of the step (always a float for JSON).
`unit`    - how to read `value`: dollars, a percentage or a plain ratio.
`formula` - the literal expression evaluated, with concrete values
            substituted (e.g. "$2000 - $800 - $1000 = $200").
`terms`   - for a sum-type step, the same expression as structured operands
            (they add up to `value`), so a renderer can stack them.
`note`    - an optional aside explaining a convention or a special case.

formula.description: The expression evaluated, with the concrete numbers filled in.
formula.title: Formula

label.description: Human-readable name of the step, e.g. 'Net Operating Income (NOI)'.
label.title: Label

note.description: Optional aside: a convention or special case behind this step.
note.title: Note

terms.description: For a sum-type step: the operands of `formula`, in order; they add up to `value`. Absent on other steps.
terms.title: Terms

unit.description: How to read `value`: 'money' = dollars, 'pct' = percent (12.5 = 12.5%), 'ratio' = a plain multiple (1.2 = 1.2x).
unit.title: Unit

value.description: The step's result. Read it with `unit`; -1 and -2 are the infinite / undefined sentinels on percentage steps.
value.title: Value

CalcStep.title: CalcStep

CalcTerm.description: One operand of a sum-type calculation step, in dollars.

label.description: Name of the operand, e.g. 'Down Payment'.
label.title: Label

sign.description: Whether the operand is added or subtracted.
sign.title: Sign

Single-file convenience shim — kept for backward compatibility.

New clients should call `/reps/upload-batch`.

Upload one or many evidence files into a per-log GCS sub-folder.

The folder + per-file URLs are returned to the frontend, which then sends
them back inside the `/reps/log` payload so the Sheet stores both the
folder URL (auditor's index page) and each file URL.
